description: This file contains utility functions and hooks related to the state dict handling of Fully Sharded Data Parallel (FSDP) modules in PyTorch. It includes mechanisms for sharding, unsharding, pre- and post-processing during state dict serialization/deserialization, and integration with various strategies like sharding and offloading.

methods.name: bool _should_unshard_params(fsdp_state: _FSDPState)
methods.description: Determines if parameters should be unsharded based on the current FSDP state and sharding strategy.

methods.name: str _convert_to_wrapped_module_name(module_name: str)
methods.description: Removes FSDP-specific prefixes from module names to normalize them.

methods.name: Iterator[tuple[str,str,str]] _param_name_infos( module: nn.Module, fsdp_state: _FSDPState )
methods.description: Yields tuples of fully qualified name, param name, and module name for parameters in a module.

methods.name: Iterator[tuple[str,str,str]] _shared_param_name_infos( module: nn.Module, fsdp_state )
methods.description: Yields tuples of shared parameter info for a module.

methods.name: None _enter_unshard_params_ctx( module: nn.Module, fsdp_state: _FSDPState, writeback: bool = False, rank0_only: bool = False, offload_to_cpu: bool = False, with_grads: bool = False, )
methods.description: Enters a context to unshard parameters for a given module in an FSDP state, with options for writeback, offloading, rank-specific unsharding, and gradient handling.

methods.name: None _exit_unshard_params_ctx(module: nn.Module, fsdp_state: _FSDPState)
methods.description: Exits the unsharding context for a module.

methods.name: None _common_pre_state_dict_hook( module: nn.Module, fsdp_state: _FSDPState, )
methods.description: Performs setup tasks common to all pre-state dict hooks, such as synchronizing device, lazy init, and resetting grad info.

methods.name: None _common_unshard_pre_state_dict_hook( module: nn.Module, fsdp_state: _FSDPState, offload_to_cpu: bool, rank0_only: bool, )
methods.description: Prepares to unshard parameters if needed before dumping state_dict.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] _common_unshard_post_state_dict_hook( module: nn.Module, fsdp_state: _FSDPState, state_dict: dict[str, Any], prefix: str, param_hook: Callable, )
methods.description: Handles post-processing after state_dict serialization, including cloning tensors and offloading buffers.

methods.name: None _full_pre_state_dict_hook( fsdp_state: _FSDPState, module: nn.Module, *args, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Prepares the FSDP module and state for full state dict serialization.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] _full_post_state_dict_hook( module: nn.Module, fsdp_state: _FSDPState, state_dict: dict[str, Any], prefix: str, )
methods.description: Post-processes the state dict after full serialization, cloning tensors, and removing prefixes.

methods.name: None _full_pre_load_state_dict_hook( module: nn.Module, fsdp_state: _FSDPState, state_dict: dict[str, Any], prefix: str, )
methods.description: Prepares to load a full state dict into the FSDP module, including lazy init and unsharding if needed.

methods.name: None _full_post_load_state_dict_hook( module: nn.Module, fsdp_state: _FSDPState, *args, **kwargs )
methods.description: Finalizes the load process by exiting unshard context after loading.

methods.name: None _local_pre_state_dict_hook( fsdp_state: _FSDPState, module: nn.Module, *args, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Prepares a module for local state dict extraction; checks parameter sharding.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] _local_post_state_dict_hook( module: nn.Module, fsdp_state: _FSDPState, state_dict: dict[str, Any], prefix: str, )
methods.description: Converts the flat_param into a ShardedTensor for local state dict, without copying.

methods.name: None _local_post_load_state_dict_hook( module: nn.Module, fsdp_state: _FSDPState, *args, **kwargs )
methods.description: No implementation, placeholder for post-processing after loading local state dict.

methods.name: None _local_pre_load_state_dict_hook( module: nn.Module, fsdp_state: _FSDPState, state_dict: dict[str, Any], prefix: str, )
methods.description: Converts a loaded ShardedTensor into a tensor and sets it as the flat_param.

methods.name: None _sharded_pre_state_dict_hook( fsdp_state: _FSDPState, module: nn.Module, *args, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Prepares module for sharded state_dict extraction, ensuring flattened and sharded strategy.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] _sharded_post_state_dict_hook( module: nn.Module, fsdp_state: _FSDPState, state_dict: dict[str, Any], prefix: str, )
methods.description: Replaces unflattened parameters with sharded versions (ShardedTensor) in the state dict.

methods.name: None _sharded_post_load_state_dict_hook( module: nn.Module, fsdp_state: _FSDPState, *args, **kwargs )
methods.description: Exits unshard context after loading sharded parameters.

methods.name: None _sharded_pre_load_state_dict_hook( module: nn.Module, fsdp_state: _FSDPState, state_dict: dict[str, Any], prefix: str, )
methods.description: Prepares module for loading a sharded state dict, combining shards into a flat parameter.

methods.name: Generator _replace_with_full_state_dict_type(fsdp_state: _FSDPState)
methods.description: Context manager to temporarily switch to full state dict mode.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] _post_state_dict_hook( module: nn.Module, state_dict: dict[str, Any], prefix: str, *args: Any, )
methods.description: Dispatcher for post-state dict processing based on the state dict type.

methods.name: None _pre_state_dict_hook( module: nn.Module, *args, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Dispatcher for pre-state dict processing based on the state dict type.

methods.name: None _set_use_dtensor(fsdp_state: _FSDPState)
methods.description: Enables DTensor usage if device mesh is present, and raises errors for incompatible configs.

methods.name: None _pre_load_state_dict_hook( module: nn.Module, state_dict: dict[str, Any], prefix: str, *args: Any, )
methods.description: Dispatcher before loading state dict, handling full, local, or sharded types.

methods.name: None _post_load_state_dict_hook( module: nn.Module, incompatible_keys: tuple[list[str], list[str]], *args: Any, )
methods.description: Dispatcher after loading state dict, handling full, local, or sharded types.

methods.name: _register_all_state_dict_hooks(state: _FSDPState)
methods.description: Registers all standard hooks for a given FSDP state, pre and post for saving and loading.

methods.name: None _register_state_dict_hooks_base( state: _FSDPState, hook_registration_fn_name: str, hook: Callable, hook_registration_fn_kwargs: dict[str, Any], )
methods.description: Helper to register individual hooks on either the state or the module handle.

methods.name: None param_hook( state_dict: dict[str, Any], prefix: str, fqn: str, )
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: param_hook(state_dict: dict[str, Any], prefix: str, fqn: str)
methods.description: unavailable
